summary: Built email templates with message preview, recipient name, scheduled send time, and action links (Review/Edit with utm_source=email_reminder). Created reminder scheduler that auto-schedules two reminders (3 days and 1 day before send time) with validation for past dates and unsubscribed users. Created api/messages.js POST endpoint that calls scheduleReminders and returns job IDs. Updated email-service.js to use the new generateReminderEmail template.
